responseMessageContents.text: The issue is that when sign-in succeeds, the auth modal doesn't close — so it looks like "nothing happens". Let me fix that by dismissing the modal when authentication completes.

responseMessageContents.text: Fixed. The sign-in was actually working — but the auth modal wasn't closing after success, so it looked like nothing happened. Now when you sign in successfully (either with the demo review account `appreview@peaknab.com` / `ReviewPeakNab2026!` or a real Supabase account), the modal will auto-dismiss and take you into the app.

responseMessageContents.title: Fix the sign-in screen to close automatically after logging in.
responseMessageContents.description: The app now properly closes the login window once you have successfully signed in, so you can start using the app immediately.
